rubric_markdown:
GRADER INSTRUCTIONS — C1 (Directional Redline (Indemnification, Vendor)) · Max /16 · Gates: Faithfulness + Directionality
ROLE: Grade the model's response against this gold rubric. Do NOT solve the task yourself. For every sub-judgment, quote the exact span of the response you relied on; a judgment with no quotable evidence scores 0. Return structured JSON per the Tier 1 template (Section 6.5). Never show this block to the model.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: Real quoted §8.1; grade edits against the clause as printed. The edit key is authored.
SEAT: You represent Vendor (Commerce One); EVERY edit must favor Vendor.
SCORING (v8 — weighted ratio): each dimension score = Σ(weight×verdict)/Σ(weight), weights critical=3/major=2/minor=1, verdict met=1/partial=0.5/not_met=0/n-a=excluded. Assign a verdict to EACH listed criterion; never assign the dimension number yourself.
FAITHFULNESS /3 (GATE): criteria — [critical] No fabricated cap figure the text cannot support; no invented third-party claims. TRIPS ONLY ON: Fabricating a specific cap figure the text cannot support; Inventing third-party claims absent from the original. DOES NOT TRIP ON: A true statement about indemnity law not misattributed to the clause.
DIRECTIONALITY /4 (GATE): criteria — [critical] EVERY edit favors Vendor (Commerce One) — near pass/fail. TRIPS ONLY ON: ANY edit that favors Corio; Any symmetric/mutual edit; Refusing to engage with one-sided advocacy. DOES NOT TRIP ON: A market-standard pro-Vendor extra (e.g. dropping 'and its Customers'; 'finally awarded' language).
COVERAGE /4: criteria — [critical, C1.edit.modifications_carveout] Carve-out for Corio's modifications; [critical, C1.edit.combination_carveout] Carve-out for combination with non-Vendor products; [critical, C1.edit.specifications_carveout] Carve-out for infringement required by Corio's design specs (most-missed); [major, C1.edit.indemnity_cap] Cap the indemnity / subordinate §8.1 to the liability cap; [minor, C1.edit.narrow_causation] Narrow causation to a third-party claim that the Software as delivered & properly used directly infringes; [minor, C1.edit.exclusive_remedy] Procure / modify / refund as sole-and-exclusive remedy (most-missed).
SOUNDNESS /3: criteria — [critical] Edits legally correct and enforceable; geographic limits applied ONLY to patents/trademarks, never copyright (Berne) — the Berne error is a dock; [major] Carve-outs drafted tightly enough to actually limit liability.
ACTIONABILITY /2: criteria — [critical] Clean consolidated redline (original struck, replacement shown, purpose noted) + market-standard vs aggressive flag.
DISCRETION VALVE (v8): if a response is not addressed by the enumerated gate conditions, return verdict not_covered on that gate (routes to human-confirm) + a proposed_condition stating the rule that would resolve it — do NOT guess trip/pass.
PROCEDURE: assign a verdict to every criterion → weighted ratio per dimension → raw = Σ max(dim)×ratio → normalize to /16 → if ANY gate tripped, cap the normalized score at 0.40 and flag it.
